metaTitle: Custom Cardboard Distance Barriers | Perfect Imprints
metaDescription: Order custom cardboard distance barriers for social distancing. Perfect for offices and events. Bulk pricing available at Perfect Imprints.
introHtml: Cardboard distance barriers offer a lightweight, eco-friendly solution for maintaining social distancing in offices, schools, and event spaces. Unlike acrylic or plastic barriers, cardboard is easily customizable with full-color printing and can be recycled after use. These barriers are ideal for temporary setups where cost and sustainability matter, such as trade show booths, registration desks, or cafeteria tables. Decorate with your logo, safety messaging, or brand colors to reinforce your company's commitment to safety while keeping your brand visible.
heroAltText: Custom cardboard distance barriers with printed logo and social distancing messaging on a desk
